text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Tracen Academy is hosting an
off-campus
party for the press and all
the sponsor companies
that support the
school.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Within the hustle and bustle, I find Sirius
Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh. Didn't think I'd see you here.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Some guests wanted to see me
personally, so I
thought, why not? I
could humor them with a
conversation or
two.
choice_data_list: 手伝いがあって。そっちは？
choice_data_list_en: I was helping out with something. How about you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I admire how easily she takes things in
stride, and
we talk for a bit. Not long
after, the party begins.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And to start things off, the Emperor
herself,
Symboli Rudolf, will perform a
ballroom dance for
us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The room erupts with applause as
Symboli Rudolf
walks in with her dance
partner. Both dancers
gracefully move in
time to the music.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their footsteps echo through the hall.
While the
guests are smitten by the
elegant performance,
Sirius Symboli
looks rather grim.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This is the most boring dance I've seen in
my life.
Hmph, there she is, playing the
model student as
usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be talking about Symboli
Rudolf... I'm
not sure I agree, though.
From what I can see, she
looks like quite
the skillful dancer.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you know what the Emperor's
motto is?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: It's "Take it easy."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Everything comes easy to her. She should be free to make any choice she wants.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But she doesn't understand the value of
that
privilege.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's a few reasons why an
Umamusume might
distance herself from
racing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Injuries, poor performance, mental
strain, family
matters, aptitudes, and so
on...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Your average Umamusume is bound to
be
burdened with at least one of these
problems.
They can never truly be free.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
When you take that into consideration,
it
becomes clear just how special she is.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She had everything she could need. She
had the
freedom everyone seeks in the
palm of her hand.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: She chose to let go of that freedom.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: She trapped herself with the idea that she should act a certain way and chose to walk the straight, narrow, and boring. Tch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli turns her severe gaze
toward the
center of the room. What she
sees is privy only to
herself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm done with this joke of a party. I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Like I care. I'm sure having the Emperor
around is
more than enough for
everyone.
choice_data_list: でも、君も踊る予定があるんじゃ……？
でも、貴方も踊る予定があるんじゃ……？
choice_data_list_en: Still, aren't you scheduled to dance too...?
But don't you have a dance planned too...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hang on now... If things are boring, then
I just
have to take matters into my own
hands.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll turn this stuffy party upside down,
dance floor
and all! Heh... Haha! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: That settles it. Give me your hand.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're not one of the Emperor's
countless
adoring puppets.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So you'll be my partner for tonight.
Don't go
embarrassing me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, she yanks my hand and pulls
me onto
the dance floor. Frazzled from
the turn of events,
I hastily try to follow
her lead.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Good, now spin! That's it, keep up with
my lead!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Did you see their faces? None of
the
guests could manage to close their
mouths. Our
dance was a masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But it made for a valuable experience,
didn't it?
Well, try not to get hooked on
that feeling.
choice_data_list_en: That was bad for my heart...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says she wants to get some fresh air,
so we
hike to somewhere higher up. We
look down at
the town and spot the
party hall.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look at that tiny box of a venue. No way
I could
stand being cooped up in that
place.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Screw the "tried and true" path. I'm
going to
destroy that old, boring path
and take the one
lined with thorns. And
someday...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'll find my way there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She points to one particular star,
dazzlingly
bright in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sirius is the brightest star out there. It
shines high
above the world. One day,
everyone'll look up to
me, just like how
they look up to that star.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The star glints in the night sky like a
gleaming
wolf's fang—sharp, savage, and
hungering for
more.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Now that wasn't too hard, was
it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A little more polish and you would've
been
perfect. You'd better work harder
if you want my
stamp of approval.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a smile on her face, Sirius Symboli
leaves the
room. I can't describe how
relieved I am that I got
through that in
one piece...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. May I have a moment of your
time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That was you dancing with Sirius,
correct? While
it wasn't on the program,
your performance did
wonders to liven
up the party.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I give you both my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. And it's not just what she did
today that
I'm grateful for.
choice_data_list: シリウスシンボリにも……？

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Her ideas are free. She's unhindered by

conformity, which leaves anyone who
sees her
mesmerized.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today's guests are only a portion of her
admirers.
But I know she's equally
beloved by the students.
Many of them
flock to her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps there is more than one star of
hope that
lights the way for those lost
and struggling...
